Public allowance mapping, decremented with raw arithmetic in transferFrom.
Whitelisted trading address bypassing the sale condition check in ensure().
Whitelist mapping granting sale bypass, set by _mints and read by ensure().
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition().
Global sale-count limit configured by init().

Maximum transfer amount limit configured by init().
Total token supply, set in constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale sale limits and minted amounts.
Token name stored at deployment.
Token symbol stored at deployment.
Hard-coded Uniswap router constant address compared in ensure().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and allowance accounting.
AMA constructor: sets owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the deployer.
External transfer that forwards msg.sender into transferFrom.
Core transfer logic performing allowance/balance updates with unchecked arithmetic.
Whitelist gate: owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale bypass, otherwise condition() must pass.
Writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any checks.
Sale-limit logic based on _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer privileged control.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as spender key for allowance authorization.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no further validation.
delegate gates the arbitrary delegatecall on msg.sender == owner.
_mints authorizes msg.sender == owner or a hard-coded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] by _value with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] and adds to balanceOf[_to].
The allowance decrement is an unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath.
The balance mutations are unchecked additions/subtractions outside SafeMath.
ensure falls through to condition(_from, _value) when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the UNI pair address of this token.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants a bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure compares _from against the hard-coded UNI router address.
condition rejects the transfer when _onSaleNum[_from] >= _saleNum.
condition disables count limiting when _saleNum is zero.
condition rejects transfers below _minSale.
condition rejects transfers above _maxSale.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the sale count limit.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall, an unsafe operation on contract storage.
_mints permanently sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing ensure().
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with a scaled value, unbacked by totalSupply.
init writes _saleNum, changing the sale-count policy.
init writes _minSale, scaling it by decimals.
init writes _maxSale, scaling it by decimals.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and each balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic.
batchSend computes total with a multiplication that can overflow.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure().
constructor sets owner to the deployer msg.sender.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
transfer receives recipient parameter _to.
transfer receives amount parameter _value.
transferFrom receives source parameter _from.
transferFrom receives destination parameter _to.
transferFrom amount _value drives the unchecked allowance and balance updates.
_value is subtracted directly from allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the _spender parameter into the allowance mapping.
approve stores the caller-supplied _value as the allowance.
delegate targets the caller-supplied address a.
delegate receives the caller-supplied calldata bytes b.
The caller-supplied bytes b are forwarded verbatim to delegatecall.
_mints credits the arbitrary spender account.
addedValue is scaled by decimals and written into balanceOf[spender].
batchSend iterates the caller-supplied recipient array _tos.
batchSend multiplies the per-recipient _value by the array length.
_tos.length is a multiplication operand that can make total overflow.
_value is a multiplication operand that can make total overflow.
local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
local total is the overflow-prone product _value * _tos.length.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only the recipient argument of transfer and has no independent lifecycle.
_value is only the amount argument of transfer and adds no separate semantics.
_from identifies the debited account inside transferFrom's authorization flow.
_to is merely the credited account inside transferFrom.
_value is the amount consumed by transferFrom's allowance and balance mutations.
_spender is only the mapping key written by approve.
_value is only the allowance value stored by approve.
address a is the delegatecall target used exclusively by delegate.
bytes b is the delegatecall payload used exclusively by delegate.
spender is only the account credited by _mints.
addedValue is only the minted amount computed by _mints.
_tos is only the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_value is only the per-recipient amount multiplied by batchSend.
total is the intermediate product whose overflow is the unsafe operation in batchSend.
